data.name: [GK-021][P0][O190][W05] Authorize customers, staff and safe historical claims
data.desc:
## Context

Owner: Agent; Kind: Implementation
Priority: P0 — foundational/safety prerequisite.
Order: 190; Wave: 5; Parallel group: W05-identity.
Requirements: C07, C08, C13, C18, A02; Design/contract revision: planning r5, K00 K02.
Agent execution policy: gpt-6-astra / high; fresh scoped worker; fresh independent reviewer.
Required input: brief, input-revision.json, Creator r2, ADRs/contracts r5 or reviewed successor, feature/screens, prerequisite evidence, SETUP and DELIVERY.
Execution check: skills/gk-plan/references/execution-check.md at start/resume; record requested/effective model, history, input hashes and checked readback. Pending.
Depends on: GK-020, GK-010, GK-003; deliverable: accepted policy/setup or tested implementation outputs; GK-020 means completed B2.
Unblocks: GK-022, GK-023, GK-025, GK-027, GK-029.
Safe in parallel with: GK-024 after all prerequisites and shared schemas/interfaces are accepted. Own proposed internal/identity and owned identity migrations. Master allocates nonconflicting migration IDs and integrates changes; neither worker edits shared contract/auth/router files concurrently.
Conflicts: shared contracts/schema/router/migrations; master coordinates edits.
Readiness at publication: blocked / specified but dependent: Identity sandbox and approved claim policy pending.

Managed authentication plus local active manager/fulfillment membership; no metadata-derived role. API exposes own history/profile/favourites and proof-based historical order claim. Claims single-use/expiring/audited; matching typed email or handle insufficient. Favourite set unique(customer,cake); archived labelled.

Rules: server-owned price/capacity/state; GBP pence, UTC/Europe/London; role+ownership; expected_version+Idempotency-Key; unknown stays pending; no network under DB locks.

Wire/state (approved GK-019 successor required):

Auth: Authorization: Bearer verified access token. Active local staff role and object owner checked on every operation; GET foreign order ->404, wrong role ->403. Error {error:{code:"STALE_VERSION",message:"Refresh this order",request_id:"opaque",retryable:false}}. Existing-object mutation carries expected_version and Idempotency-Key; same key/different body ->409 KEY_REUSED.

POST /api/v1/custom-requests accepts paired inspiration_id/image_revision_id (both omitted/null for generic requests), servings, desired_date, requested_changes and approved contact fields; returns request_id/version/inspiration_id/image_revision_id/summary/handoff_state:"not_sent". POST /api/v1/reorders {source_order_id} returns current choices, never pays. GET /api/v1/me/orders owner-only; PUT/DELETE /api/v1/me/favourites/{cake_id} is idempotent set membership. POST /api/v1/admin/orders links one agreed quote version, revalidates resources and uses normal collection path.

Proposed: API10s/DB2s/provider5s; retries1m/5m/15m/1h then manager, alert15m. Validate; retain unknown funds.

Customer boundary: public archived detail404; own history/favourites retain safe snapshots. Missing approved allergen disclosure disables buying. Identity/session/claim design requires GK-019/provider; sign-out does not revoke issued JWTs. K02A carries explicit selected image_revision_id and no persisted sent claim.

Creator GK-010 supplies selected account/resource/verified first-manager subject only. This ticket derives exact callback/origin settings from GK-020 and the chosen provider/session contract, asks Creator to enter those settings, and proves valid/invalid callbacks, current local manager bootstrap/disable, ownership and non-enumerating claim behavior. No circular requirement for GK-010 to run these application checks.

## To dos

T1. Red: smallest AC1–AC3 fixture assertion; infrastructure failure is not red.
T2. Implement data/API/UI/recovery with snapshots/auth/idempotency (AC1–AC3).
T3. Integrate migrations/consumers/audit/notices; verify real DB/provider failures (AC1–AC3).
T4. Green -> refactor -> rerun affected checks; record revision/results (AC4).
T5. Complete AC4 review/delivery/acceptance evidence; no implied deployment.

## Not to dos

No unrelated cleanup, registrations, leaked secrets or releases/deployments without authority. No app execution now; Done needs Creator acceptance.

## Acceptance Criteria

AC1. Red API fixtures: customer A cannot read/cancel/claim B order (404), inactive staff and metadata-forged role cannot act (403).
AC2. Valid token checks issuer/audience/signature/expiry/rotation; verified subject + claim proof links once; replay/reuse/other subject rejected without data leak.
AC3. Profile/favourite CRUD validates escaped handle and ownership, handles archived cake, current actor authorization on idempotent replay, and least-privilege storage access.
AC4. Record exact input/tested revision, results, independent review and Creator acceptance on Trello; account for all related PRs, required review/checks, native auto-merges and main CI. Release/deploy/smoke only when separately authorized and in scope.

Test prerequisite: GK-020 B2 verifies pinned runners before this card is Ready. Planned Go: go test ./..., go test -race ./..., go test -tags=integration ./... with disposable PostgreSQL; UI: npm run check, npm test, npm run build + approved browser runner. Provider cases use controlled sandbox accounts/recipients and actual IDs; mocks are not provider proof. No application tests ran during planning.

Publication snapshot of the independently reviewed planning packet. Trello is the live execution record; application work has not started.
